description: DAO-COLL on a writable copy: the Fields of Typed read with Name and OrdinalPosition (bounded at 16); OrdinalPosition of TLong is put to 0, then of TText to 99, then of K to -1, then of TInt to 2; after each put, the same read, and after the last put also after Fields.Refresh and from a fresh Fields collection. A snapshot on Typed then reads the field order.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
